description: Legislative Update Making History: Passing the Heartbeat Bill The Heartbeat Bill, which outlaws abortions in the state of South Carolina after a heartbeat has been detected (around 6-8 weeks of pregnancy), passed the House this week and was signed into law by Governor McMaster on Thursday. This long-anticipated bill passed the House last year only […]
title: Legislative Update: Week 6, 2021 - Tommy Pope Speaker Pro Tempore for South Carolina House 47
